mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sorrowing or grieving deeply.

शुच to be sorrowful, intens. v., शानच aff.

Intumescence, swelling.
E.
शुष to dry, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
1 Suction, sucking.
2 Drying up.
m. (-णः)
One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA, or CUPID.
E.
शुष to dry, ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having dried up.
E.
शुष to dry, causal v., क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dried, dried up, desiccated.
E.
शुष to dry, aff. क्त.

ind.
A particle of reproach or contempt.
